call.transcript: Gole Market ke paas ek ghar mein aag lagi hai! Main Connaught Place area mein hoon, the whole upper floor is on fire, flames shooting out of the windows. I don't know if anyone is still inside!
Bhai please aao jaldi, CP ke paas ek ghar mein fire lag gayi hai, Gole Market side, bahut bada fire hai, kisne 112 call kiya already but main bhi kar raha hoon!

notes: Different passerby reporting the same Gole Market fire near CP

call.transcript: Oh god okay main apne flat mein hoon aur fire alarm baj raha hai aur main ne apna darwaza khola toh poora hallway smoke se bhara hua hai, main kuch nahi dekh sakta pehle paanch foot ke baad. Main Karol Bagh ke apartment complex mein sixth floor pe hoon. Mujhe nahi pata aag kahan lagi hai but smoke bahut kaali aur ghani hai aur burning plastic ki smell aa rahi hai. Mere neighbour ne lift try ki aur lift mein se dhuan nikal raha tha. Mujhe asthma hai aur main already darwaze mein khara hoon toh breathe karna mushkil ho raha hai. Mera husband stairwell ki taraf ja raha hai. Mere samne wale flat mein do chhote bacche hain aur maine knock kiya but koi nahin aaya. Please abhi help bhejo, firefighters ke saath ladders chahiye, aur ambulances chahiye kyunki log yahan oxygen ki zaroorat padegi. I don't know how many people are in this building but it's a big complex, poora bhara hua hai.

notes: Long rambling call — caller trapped on 6th floor with asthma, children unaccounted for

call.transcript: Fire at Chandni Chowk! The kirana shop andar se poori tarah jal rahi hai aur aas paas wali dukanon mein bhi aag phadkne wali hai. Old Delhi ke purane buildings hain yahan, please jaldi aao, ek baar aag faili toh mushkil ho jaayega!

notes: Caller aware of old building density in Old Delhi — correct escalation of concern

call.transcript: Gaadi mein aag lag gayi hai airport expressway pe, IGI Airport Terminal 3 ke bilkul paas. Driver ka darwaza khula hua hai — shayad nikal gaya? But main sure nahi hoon. Engine compartment fully jal raha hai aur passenger area mein spread ho raha hai.

notes: Ambiguous severity — open door suggests driver escaped but not confirmed

call.transcript: Uh, Rohini Sector 7 mein ek government school ke peeche garbage dump mein aag lag gayi hai. Badi aag ho gayi hai aur dump school wall se chhe foot door hai. Hawa bhi chal rahi hai. Bacche nahi hain — school band hai — but agar wall tak pahunchi toh building tak ja sakti hai.

notes: Ambiguous severity — contained garbage fire but proximity to school building with wind could escalate

call.transcript: India Gate ke paas lawn mein aag lag gayi hai! Sukhi ghans pakad li hai aur bahut tez fail rahi hai tree line ki taraf. Already fifty foot wide ho gayi hai aur hawa tez ho rahi hai. Kuch log park mein the jo bhaag rahe hain.

PLEASE JALDI BHEJO, mere padosi ke ghar mein aag lagi hai! Main hoon... hey bhagwan... Lajpat Nagar mein? Nahi wait, yeh Saket hai, green gate wali building, second lane mein! Poora porch jal raha hai aur andar se bacchon ki awaaz aa rahi hai. Main darwaze tak nahi ja sakta, aag block kar rahi hai. PLEASE!

notes: Conflicting address — caller gives Lajpat Nagar first then corrects to Saket; children audibly inside

call.transcript: Um, main Nehru Place ke paas khada hoon aur ek badi commercial building ki second floor se bahut dhuan aa raha hai. Koi flames nahi dikh rahi, kuch overheated equipment ho sakta hai? Lekin smell ajeeb si hai, thodi chemical. Alarm bhi nahi baj raha jahan tak main sun sakta hoon.

notes: Ambiguous severity — smoke present but caller doubts themselves; no visible flames

call.transcript: Garage mein aag lag gayi hai Hauz Khas Village ke main road pe. Garage fully jal raha hai but family bahar nikal aayi lagti hai. Flames ab main house ki side wall ko chhoo rahi hain. Aapko tez rehna hoga.
MERE PATI BREATHE NAHI KAR RAHE. AIIMS HOSPITAL PARKING LOT. PLEASE JALDI AANA.

notes: Extremely terse — location and chief complaint clear despite minimal words

call.transcript: AIIMS hospital parking lot mein bahar emergency entry ke paas ek aadmi gira hua hai, hosh nahi hai usse. Main gaadi par jaa raha tha aur mila. Ek aurat yahan hai jo bol rahi hai doctor hai aur CPR kar rahi hai. Please ambulance bhejo AIIMS parking ko abhi!

notes: Bystander reporting same incident — CPR already in progress confirms same event

call.transcript: Mere bache ko kuch fas gaya hai gale mein Saket Select Citywalk mall mein! She can't breathe, blue ho rahi hai! Wo teen saal ki hai, angoor kha rahi thi. Please please jaldi aao, hum food court mein hain!

I think my friend overdosed at a party in Hauz Khas Village. He's on the floor, completely unresponsive, barely breathing. Main usse jagane ki koshish kar raha hoon but koi response nahi. I don't know what he took. Please ambulance bhejo immediately.

Meri colleague Nehru Place pe kuch le aayi, I don't know what it was. Wo technically jaag rahi hai but bahut out of it hai — words blur ho rahe hain, aankhein roll kar rahi hain. Baar baar bol rahi hai theek hoon but theek nahi hai. Shayad aur bura ho jaaye.

notes: Ambiguous severity — patient conscious and denying emergency but showing decline signs

call.transcript: Mere papa India Gate ke paas gir gaye hain aur main unhe utha nahi pa raha. 78 saal ke hain aur koi response nahi de rahe. Hum India Gate dekhne aaye the aur seedhiyon pe gir gaye. Sir ke peeche khoon aa raha hai.

Worker fell off scaffolding near Akshardham Temple construction site. He's conscious, talking to us, but his leg is clearly broken — bone might be through the skin. His arm may also be broken. Bahut dard mein hai but alert aur stable hai.

notes: Non-critical MEDICAL — patient conscious, alert, and stable despite serious injuries

call.transcript: Kuch bahut wrong hai mere papa ke saath CP mein! Unka aadha chehra ek taraf latkaa hua hai. Unhone apna haath uthane ki koshish ki aur nahi hua. Bolne ki koshish kar rahe hain but words ulte nikalte hain, main samajh nahi pa raha. Main sochta hoon stroke ho raha hai. Hum Connaught Place pe hain.

Mere bete ko Lotus Temple gardens ke paas makhhi ne kaata aur uska gala sujan raha hai. Wo allergic hai, humne EpiPen use kiya but tez nahi lag raha. Breathe karne mein takleef ho rahi hai. Hum Lotus Temple ke bahar hain, please jaldi aao.

Yamuna Bank metro station ke bahar ek aadmi pada hua hai, hosh bilkul nahi hai usse. Maine uska kandha hilaya but koi response nahi. Saans le raha hai ya nahi clear nahi. Hont thode neele lag rahe hain. Kaafi der se wahan pada hai, koi nahi tha toh maine call kiya.

Meri colleague Red Fort ke paas bahut ajeeb tarah se behave kar rahi hai, hum ek function pe hain. Confused hai, kaamp rahi hai, bahut pasina aa raha hai. Pehle usne bola diabetes hai, phir yeh sab shuru ho gaya. Baithke thodi baatein kar rahi hai but kuch samajh nahi aa raha. Main nahi jaanta yeh emergency hai ya juice pilane se theek ho jaayegi.

notes: Ambiguous severity — possible hypoglycemia, caller uncertain; patient still responsive

call.transcript: Oh my god okay sun lo meri wife 38 weeks pregnant hai aur unka paani abhi toot gaya, lagbhag ek ghante pehle, aur contractions already do minute pe aa rahe hain, aur hum Dwarka Sector 21 se hospital jaane ki koshish kar rahe the but gaadi start nahi ho rahi, aur unke bol rahi hain bacha aa raha hai ABHI, woh chilla rahi hain, aur mainne yeh pehle kabhi nahi kiya, main bilkul ghbaar raha hoon, hum Dwarka Sector 21 mein ghar pe hain, please koi bhejo jo jaanta ho kya karna hai, woh bol rahi hain bacha aa raha hai aur mujhe nahi pata kya karna hai please abhi aao...

notes: Long rambling call — imminent delivery, panicked first-time father in Dwarka

call.transcript: Bahut bura accident hua hai Connaught Place ke paas! Do gaadiyaan takrayi hain inner circle mein, ek ne signal tod diya. Log zakhmi hain — ek aurat ke sir se khoon aa raha hai aur ek aur passenger apna haath pakad raha hai. Main madad karne aa raha hoon.

Accident near Rajiv Chowk, CP pe, do gaadiyaan ek doosre se takrayi hain — ek ne light tod di lagta hai. Main dekh sakta hoon at least ek aadmi zakhmi hai, driver seat pe jhukte hua. Doosri gaadi ke airbags bhi chhoot gaye hain.

notes: Different witness, slightly fewer injuries visible from their angle

call.transcript: Ek car ne pedestrian ko maara India Gate ke paas! Woh banda karib pandrah foot hawa mein uchhala aur bilkul nahi hil raha! Car ruk gayi. Zameen pe khoon hai. Woh bilkul still aur unresponsive hai. Please jaldi aao, mujhe nahi lagta woh breathe kar raha hai!

Hello, ek minor accident hua hai New Delhi Railway Station ke paas, side exit wali gali mein. Do gaadiyaan thodi si takrayi hain. Dono drivers bahar hain aur chal phir rahe hain, koi seriously hurt nahi lagta. Bas police report ke liye koi chahiye.

Scooty accident hai airport expressway pe near IGI Airport! Banda skid karke gir gaya. Helmet crack ho gayi hai. Woh hosh mein hai aur chilla raha hai but uski taang bahut buri tarah tooti hui lag rahi hai, shayad compound fracture. Uthh nahi pa raha. Scooty abhi bhi road pe padi hai.

Ek baccha cycle pe tha near Lajpat Nagar Central Market aur ek gaadi ne use mara! Bacha lagbhag 8-9 saal ka hai, ro raha hai, haatho pe road rash hai. Car driver ruk gaya. Bacche ne helmet nahi pahna tha aur uska sir zameen se lag gaya. Hosh mein hai but confused lag raha hai.

Oh god airport expressway pe IGI Airport ke paas ek bahut bada pile-up hua hai, abhi abhi, do minute pehle. Main ne ginye — char ya paanch gaadiyaan, ek bus bhi hai jo jackknife ho gayi. Kaanch bikhra hua hai, engines se steam aa rahi hai, aur main dekh sakta hoon at least do gaadiyaon mein log trapped hain. Ek gaadi poori taraf kar ke palti hai. Ek bacche ki awaaz aa rahi hai ek gaadi se. Ek aurat ek khidki se aadhi bahar latkee hui hai, hil nahi rahi. Main registered nurse hoon aur main madad karne ja raha hoon but mujhe backup chahiye ABHI. Aur sun — bus se petrol leak ho raha hai, smell aa rahi hai — yeh aag mein badal sakta hai. Aap ko fire trucks bhi bhejne honge, sirf ambulance nahi. Yeh mass casualty situation hai. Please jo bhi ho, sab bhejo.

notes: Long call from nurse — mass casualty, fuel leak fire risk, child trapped

call.transcript: Ek car ne kisi aurat ko maara near Hauz Khas Village aur bhaag gayi! Woh zameen pe hai, hosh mein hai, chilla rahi hai dard mein, uski taang bahut buri tarah tooti hua lag rahi hai. Car red thi, Outer Ring Road ki taraf gayi.

Kashmere Gate ISBT ke paas se nikalne wali gali mein ek auto rickshaw palat gaya. Driver road pe baith ke hai, hosh mein hai lekin dazed lag raha hai — shayad concussion. Dono passengers bahar nikal aaye. Ek aurat bahut dard mein hai, apna haath pakad rahi hai.

Ek gaadi ek dukaan mein ghus gayi hai! Main sochta hoon Karol Bagh main market mein hai... actually Ajmal Khan Road ho sakta hai, ekdum paas mein hain. Ek banda gaadi aur counter ke beech mein phansa hua hai, chilla raha hai. Dukaan ke andar kaafi log hain. Please fire aur ambulance bhejo.

notes: Conflicting address — caller gives Karol Bagh main market then second-guesses to Ajmal Khan Road

call.transcript: CHANDNI CHOWK MEIN ABHI LOOT HO RAHI HAI. CHHURI HAI. POLICE BHEJO ABHI.

notes: Extremely terse — caller likely hiding; location and threat type clear

call.transcript: Koi banda maar raha hai ek aadmi ko Hazrat Nizamuddin station ke bahar! Attacker ke haath mein lohe ki rod hai aur victim zameen pe hai, uthh nahi raha. Attacker abhi bhi maar raha hai. Bahut khoon aa raha hai. Please jaldi aao, yeh banda marr jaayega!

Koi maar ke ghus raha hai mere flat mein Rohini Sector 7 mein! Main khidki ka sheesha tootte ki awaaz sun sakta hoon. Main bedroom mein band hoon apne do bacchon ke saath. Please jaldi aao, mere paas chhote bacche hain!

Hello, main kuch suspicious report karna chahta hoon Dwarka metro ke paas. Ek aadmi karib do ghante se ek dark car mein baitha hua playground ko dekh raha hai. Woh jaata hai aur wapas aa jaata hai. Shayad main galat hoon, lekin yeh theek nahi lagta.

notes: Ambiguous severity — no confirmed threat; caller themselves uncertain

call.transcript: Meri padosan bahut chikh rahi hai, kuch toot raha hai andar. Phir thodi der ke liye sannata aaya aur main sochne laga call na karoon, phir dobara shuru ho gaya. Ab woh madad ke liye cheekh rahi hai. Woh hain... main sochta hoon Karol Bagh mein... ya Patel Nagar wali taraf, bilkul saath mein hai. Please bhejo, pehle bhi ho chuka hai but aaj bahut bura lag raha hai.

notes: Conflicting address — caller gives Karol Bagh then second-guesses; prior incident history

call.transcript: Saket Select Citywalk mall ke main entrance ke paas stabbing hua hai! Log bhaag rahe hain aur chikh rahe hain. Victim zameen pe hai, bahut khoon hai. Attacker mall ke andar bhaag gaya. Please police aur ambulance bhejo abhi!
Meri gaadi chheen li Nehru Place ke paas! Do aadmi the, ek ke paas chhuri thi. Unhone mujhe driver seat se kheencha. Main theek hoon but please unhe pakdo — Outer Ring Road ki taraf nikle hain.

CP mein ek banda stab hua hai! Woh zameen pe inner circle ke paas hai, apna pet pakde hua hai, bahut khoon aa raha hai. Jo kiya woh Palika Bazaar ki taraf bhaag gaya. Victim hosh mein hai but bahut tezi se khoon kho raha hai. Jaldi please.

Chandni Chowk ke paas ek imarat mein LPG cylinder blast ho sakta hai — gas ki bahut tez smell aa rahi hai puri building mein! Hum log bahar nikal rahe hain lekin main nahi jaanta andar kaun hai abhi. Please fire brigade aur hazmat bhejo, yeh sirf chhoti si smell nahi hai!
Bijli ka taar gir gaya hai Rohini Sector 7 mein, aandhi ki wajah se. Taar zameen pe hai aur sparking kar raha hai. Road block ho gayi hai. Koi zakhmi nahi lagta lekin log bahar aa ke dekh rahe hain.

Chemical spill hai Kashmere Gate ISBT ke paas, loading area mein. Ek forklift se drum gira aur kuch peela liquid bah raha hai. Workers khansi kar rahe hain aur aankhein jal rahi hain. Hum log hawa ke upar ki taraf aaye hain but ek cloud ban raha hai. Hum nahi jaante kya chemical hai.

Hazrat Nizamuddin underpass mein monsoon ki wajah se bahut paani bhar gaya hai! Gaadiyaan hood level tak doob gayi hain. Drivers bahar nikal gaye hain but gaadiyaan submerged ho rahi hain. Paani aur bhar raha hai, road completely band hai.

India Gate ke paas ek bada ped gira hai, poori road block ho gayi hai. Bijli ke taar bhi ped mein uljhe hain lekin spark nahi dikh rahi. Koi zakhmi nahi, koi aas paas nahi tha. Bas road poori taraf se band hai.

Main samne wali building se call kar raha hoon — Karol Bagh ke apartment complex mein aag lagi hai! Kaafi floors se smoke aa raha hai. Log fire escape pe hain. Alarms baj rahe hain. Yeh bahut serious lag raha hai, please help bhejo immediately.

notes: Neighbor across the street reporting same Karol Bagh apartment fire — exterior view confirms multiple floors

call.transcript: Main woh driver hoon jisne galti se pedestrian ko maara India Gate ke paas. Main ruk gaya fauran. Woh banda nahi uthh raha, maine pulse check karne ki koshish ki but mujhe pata nahi. Bahut khoon hai. Please jaldi aao, mujhe nahi pata kya karoon.

notes: Driver calling in — confirms same incident from at-fault party's perspective

call.transcript: Main Saket Select Citywalk mein ek dukaan mein band hoon. Maine stabbing nahi dekhi but main ne logo ko bhagte dekha aur entrance ke paas zameen pe khoon dikh raha hai. Kya police aa rahi hai? Please mujhe batao kya ho raha hai bahar.

notes: Employee locked inside mall — confirms blood visible near entrance, active panic

call.transcript: Main building manager hoon, Chandni Chowk ke paas wale flats ka. Ek resident ne report kiya gas smell aa rahi hai. Main basement mein gaya check karne — confirm kar raha hoon, utility corridor mein bahut tez natural gas ki smell hai. Main abhi evacuation shuru kar raha hoon. Fire brigade aur gas company dono ko bhejo immediately.

notes: Building manager confirming same gas leak — professional caller, initiating evacuation

call.transcript: There's an injured man near Hazrat Nizamuddin station. Attacker bhaag gaya jab maine awaaz lagayi. Victim zameen pe pada hai, sir se khoon aa raha hai, hosh mein hai but uthh nahi pa raha. Please police aur ambulance Nizamuddin bhejo.

notes: Bystander who shouted at attacker — attacker fled; caller arrived mid-event
